content: I've notices when my screen is at most 1000px wide, the sidebar on the right hand side of the docs pages doesn't show up. Is there a way to access this without making my screen wider? It has the "imports" and "imported by" dropdowns which are extremely useful and I don't know of another way to easily get this information.
Not super helpful but you can zoom out
I'm often using docs from my phone, which doesn't have a 1000px wide screen, and I don't see a zoom out option in the menu...
idk what you're using, but on Chrome on Android you can toggle "Desktop site" on and then zoom out (an option in the menu) and the RHS does show up
I tried that and it's still not wide enough, I don't see a zoom out option in desktop mode either.
